rules.title: Preserve complete contained workspace bytes
rules.breakpoint: Hidden, ignored and uncommitted files silently omitted; archive member handling loses directories or modes.
rules.cause_and_solution: Git status is not a file inventory. Archive contained filesystem entries and verify their contents before publication.
rules.required_behavior: Include ignored/uncommitted bytes and ordinary contained Git history; do not follow external links.
rules.remaining_gap: Live databases and unsaved application memory are not atomic snapshots. External Git directories/worktrees/submodules require explicit support.

rules.title: Hashes decide meaningful changes
rules.breakpoint: Equal-size edits restore their mtime, or source content changes during archive construction.
rules.cause_and_solution: Metadata is only a scheduling hint. Hash content; compare source before/after and verify archived members. A typed SourceChanged during a backup is a deferred attempt, not a persistent generic error that shadows later manual scans. Preserve attempt history separately from live verification and retain ordinary I/O/corruption failures.
rules.required_behavior: Reject unstable snapshots; preserve old backups; detect same-size/same-mtime edits. Manual Rescan now must recover a deferred source-change display without starting a backup or erasing its diagnostic history. Continued writes stay Checking again; a stable comparison may become backed up only with matching upload evidence, or backup pending when edits remain. Real failures remain visible after rescanning.
rules.remaining_gap: Concurrent writes can force retries. No filesystem snapshot or transactional database capture is provided.

rules.title: Finder-only hints cannot cause broad replacements
rules.breakpoint: Repeated .DS_Store writes look like edits; a whole-schedule check rebuilds unchanged repos.
rules.cause_and_solution: Classify Finder/Git/project differences separately; ignore only ordinary .DS_Store trigger changes while retaining honest full-match status.
rules.required_behavior: No replacement for Finder-only writes; build only selected meaningfully changed/new/damaged repos.
rules.remaining_gap: Other metadata such as AppleDouble remains protected. Never generalize this exception to arbitrary hidden files.

rules.title: Unavailable verification is not corruption
rules.breakpoint: iCloud placeholders/timeouts/permissions produce read failures and can trigger unnecessary rebuilds.
rules.cause_and_solution: Separate OSError availability from checksum/archive-format failures; defer unavailable reads instead of rebuilding.
rules.required_behavior: Keep index/archive intact on unavailable reads, disclose the failure, then reuse or replace after recovery.
rules.remaining_gap: Conservative deferral also delays genuinely changed sources. Other RuntimeError classifications and real provider races remain review points.

rules.title: Retain old backup until exact replacement is safe
rules.breakpoint: Copy/index errors, stale cloud receipts or 100% progress lead to premature deletion.
rules.cause_and_solution: Persist a verified replacement; gate pruning on fresh acknowledgement for its exact archive identity.
rules.required_behavior: Never prune on progress alone, missing/old receipts or failed publication; preserve unknown/legacy files.
rules.remaining_gap: Network outage, quota exhaustion and full-disk behavior need controlled live fault runs; mocked transitions are not provider guarantees.

rules.title: Display decisions need fresh evidence
rules.breakpoint: Green check uses old archive data, stale hashes, missing upload flags or an unavailable helper.
rules.cause_and_solution: Use the shared status policy and join archive/observation/run identities; revoke stale/failed receipts. Preserve backend snapshots and log typed client freshness separately; compare views only with matching freshness context.
rules.required_behavior: Green requires fresh content verification and exact-archive upload acknowledgement. Display policy 5 also allows the existing ordinary .DS_Store-only exception when project files and Git match; raw comparison remains different and finder-only evidence is retained. Older policies retain their original meaning. Absent view receipts do not prove agreement. Selected timing receipts compare original private dates and bounded codes; exact dates never enter shareable diagnostics. Policy 6 checks every horizontal card receipt while details are collapsed or expanded, plus the one selected expanded timing line when present. Missing, hidden or incorrect compact text cannot be proven by an expanded-panel receipt.
rules.remaining_gap: Freshness override and replay have typed automated coverage. Final native delayed-start/timeout/cache-expiry/recovery correlation remains open; progress percentages/pixels are separately unproven. See PRO_RELIABILITY_ACCEPTANCE.md.

rules.title: Schedule and power policy stay per repo
rules.breakpoint: A power transition pauses incorrectly, resets unrelated timers or starts all repos after one edit.
rules.cause_and_solution: Track effective per-repo settings and cadence; recheck power before automatic work and preserve unattempted clocks.
rules.required_behavior: Battery defaults have no after-edit backups; manual-only works; a selected automatic plan cannot force unrelated repos.
rules.remaining_gap: Physical battery transitions, full sleep/wake and logout/login cycles still require hardware smoke tests.

rules.title: Diagnostics cannot break or mutate backups
rules.breakpoint: Full disk, partial records, rotation or logging recursion stops backups or produces fake edits.
rules.cause_and_solution: Bound private JSONL storage; tolerate write loss; exclude diagnostics from monitored/saved data. Record unobserved gaps honestly.
rules.required_behavior: Backup operation survives log failure; malformed records are bounded; diagnostic activity creates no backup changes.
rules.remaining_gap: The app cannot observe while powered off. Missing records are evidence gaps, not successful recovery.

rules.title: Shared diagnostics have an explicit type contract
rules.breakpoint: A new log field, raw error, nested payload or exact timestamp leaks through the export.
rules.cause_and_solution: Use separately reviewed field-specific enums/types, fresh aliases and bounded relative measurements; reject unknown events and values.
rules.required_behavior: No names/paths/raw hashes/arbitrary text/exact dates/exact sizes; exclude private alias key from previews.
rules.remaining_gap: Operational patterns remain bounded facts. User-written report prose is separate; a preview and confidentiality reminder cannot guarantee it contains no personal information.

rules.title: Local HTML APIs cannot widen filesystem access
rules.breakpoint: Untrusted origin/frame/path or stale JSON revision changes files outside its scope.
rules.cause_and_solution: Keep loopback Host/Origin/token and revision guards; resolve allowed paths; native bridge accepts fixed actions and valid repo IDs.
rules.required_behavior: Reject cross-origin and arbitrary path/payload requests; report previews cannot redirect their destination.
rules.remaining_gap: Credential-backed GitHub delivery and other cloud destinations are unimplemented and need their own threat model/tests.

rules.title: Restore audit must independently verify every supported entry
rules.breakpoint: Archive corruption/path traversal, input mutation or receiving umask hides a broken restore.
rules.cause_and_solution: Use an independently captured manifest, trusted input identities, safe isolated extraction and Git fsck/history checks. Explicitly restore link modes without changing targets.
rules.required_behavior: Reject bad identities/unsafe paths/input mutations and compare full manifest plus contained Git facts.
rules.remaining_gap: Synthetic audit tests do not prove current iCloud delivery. Actual independent receive/restore needs two-device evidence and cannot validate restored app/macros semantics.

rules.title: Installation and restart must load the tested release
rules.breakpoint: Missing runtime module/route, stale native web view or launch-job reload fails after copying new code.
rules.cause_and_solution: Validate package/asset dependencies; retain old runtime; restart existing registered jobs; verify installed hashes and helper build identity before considering deployment complete.
rules.required_behavior: Compiled native sources and packaged modules/routes must agree; local diagnostics must disclose interrupted runs.
rules.remaining_gap: Live install, rollback, login-item registration and per-device served UI checks remain manual. Native compilation alone does not prove launchd/iCloud integration. The acceptance harness now hashes a single Pro-built payload, guards staging identities and restores journaled daily jobs independently on controller loss. Actual watchdog interruption and identical two-Mac native matrix remain required. Air native permission probes require a uniquely owned Applications copy registered with LaunchServices; temporary-path apps failed notification client validation. Clean two-host permission repeats and real controller-interruption acceptance remain open. Isolated standard-account staging uses separate account-owned watchdogs and a shared read-only lock; the daily restoration guard waits for test-job cleanup and rejects an unknown helper on the fixed port. Real cross-account controller-loss acceptance remains required.

rules.title: A report sends only its exact consented payload once
rules.breakpoint: Timeouts, double-clicks, crashes, account switches or unsafe preview/destination changes can publish the wrong report or duplicate it.
rules.cause_and_solution: Freeze and hash the exact public preview; require explicit Send/account confirmation; persist sending before POST under a process-safe lock; reconcile ambiguous outcomes against exact authored issue bytes without automatically reposting. Credentials remain in native Keychain/backend memory.
rules.required_behavior: Fixed product tracker and approved diagnostic text only. Durable exact-identity receipts, retained drafts, no background sending, no token/prose in operational logs or HTML credential handling. Account verification is not proof of issue-write permission; denied submissions explain token/repository/Issues access and preserve the exact draft for explicit retry.
rules.remaining_gap: GitHub list visibility can lag creation; absent or changed issues after ambiguous POST remain unconfirmed, requiring manual investigation rather than blind resend. Reconciliation scans at most 2000 authored issues. Tokens require explicit native setup; fine-grained tokens for non-owner public contributions have GitHub limitations. MacBook Pro native token entry and public delivery were accepted on 2026-10-09 (issue #3). Air credential setup and public non-owner onboarding remain untested. HTTP 401/403 share one access-denied code; permission absence, expired credentials, rate limiting and account policy are not individually diagnosed.

rules.title: Reporting is reachable from the primary menu-bar surface
rules.breakpoint: Backend and syntax checks pass while the shipped menu has no reporting entry point.
rules.cause_and_solution: Load the same report controller and stylesheet in both shipped surfaces; check actual required controls and run compose, preview and explicit-send behavior for each HTML entry point.
rules.required_behavior: Both surfaces offer bug and feature reports, preserve separate in-memory drafts, show the exact preview, and post only after explicit Send.
rules.remaining_gap: A mocked DOM/API regression proves controller wiring, not native WebKit layout, modal focus, secure token onboarding or live GitHub response. Computer-use checks on the installed menu and a narrow viewport remain required.

rules.title: Workspace selection preserves identity and copy scope
rules.breakpoint: A new source mode changes existing IDs, aliases duplicate a source, missing folders replace good archives with empty copies, or configuration changes race backup source selection.
rules.cause_and_solution: Persist a validated canonical registry with retained inactive identities; preserve legacy IDs; reject overlaps and changed locations; bind revision-safe configuration saves and backup source selection to the same lock.
rules.required_behavior: Migration preserves backups, scoped JSON and schedules; only active approved sources can be copied; source removal preserves current archives; unavailable/retargeted sources fail without empty replacements; configuration events export no paths. Copy activity, error attribution, diagnostic projections and problem episodes use workspace IDs so duplicate names cannot share status.
rules.remaining_gap: Core source-selection UI is implemented and accepted on Pro at 5e24009. Real disk-image unmount/substitution/remount passed. Corrected native simultaneous selection and isolated TCC acceptance remain open; destination/naming migration is later work.

rules.title: Review exact source selections before saving
rules.breakpoint: Folder discovery changes after review; cancelled or stale native picker result updates a different draft; selection UI saves without disclosing removal.
rules.cause_and_solution: Keep folder choice local until backend validation, bind the review to the current registry and candidate inventory, and correlate native picker results to a single request. Canonicalize native selections with POSIX realpath so macOS pathname aliases do not duplicate draft entries.
rules.required_behavior: Review lists exact canonical paths and removals; stale review is rejected; cancel and failed review never save; picker accepts only exact main menu frame and typed request IDs.
rules.remaining_gap: Native simultaneous selection exposed a pathname alias duplicate; fixed and regression-tested. Corrected native cancel/removal/review/save/restart repeat remains open after computer-use timeout; native bridge and draft checks run in the gate. Air native acceptance at be02a30 exposed a popover covering the independent NSOpenPanel. The menu now closes only for the picker lifetime and reopens its retained draft; actual choose/cancel/save/restart regression on both Macs is required. Air b97fdf2 native choose/cancel/dedup/remove/review/save/restart checks passed against private registry/archive evidence; the complete re-add/removal sequence and Pro repeat remain open.

rules.title: Access failure cannot publish an incomplete backup
rules.breakpoint: Denied source reads and destination writes can be confused with empty or changed content.
rules.cause_and_solution: Retain errno and classify access/unavailable/I/O outcomes without claiming a specific macOS privacy decision. Continue independent repos and recover after access returns.
rules.required_behavior: No partial archive or replacement of the previous verified backup; access failures remain visible and recoverable.
rules.remaining_gap: Actual macOS privacy refusal/revocation and installed readiness UI require isolated native acceptance; POSIX tests do not establish TCC behavior.

rules.title: A source path is not a source identity
rules.breakpoint: A different directory or mounted volume can occupy the saved canonical path.
rules.cause_and_solution: Persist directory file ID and macOS volume UUID, retain stable workspace IDs, and check identity before scan/copy/publication. Explicit reviewed selection adopts replacements.
rules.required_behavior: Missing or substituted sources never replace known-good archives. Original volumes recover without resetting schedules.
rules.remaining_gap: Real disposable macOS disk-image unmount/replacement/remount passed at 7d21621. Physical hot-unplug is outside this pass; sustained races and unusual/cloned filesystem identities remain untested.

rules.title: Readiness reflects the actual helper and optional permissions
rules.breakpoint: Native folder choice can succeed while the background process cannot read files; notifications can be mistaken for a backup prerequisite.
rules.cause_and_solution: Contextual native notification requests and guarded helper-owned access probes expose unchecked/blocked/unavailable/changed states separately from backup/upload success. Track request progress separately from OS authorization and make an interrupted request retryable after restart; native readiness and JavaScript request-state regressions run in the gate. Enter the Python helper through the signed native app executable using execv, preserving the launchd PID/runtime/config while giving macOS an app responsibility identity. Packaging and native exit/signal checks run in the gate.
rules.required_behavior: No blanket privilege demand; notification refusal does not prevent backup. Login registration must match this installation.
rules.remaining_gap: Actual macOS permission acceptance remains required on both hosts for the final candidate. Air controlled probes showed that physical console unlock, AssociatedBundleIdentifiers alone and direct Python did not resolve helper EPERM. A Pro-built native executable entering the same interpreter produced an actual Desktop prompt; explicit refusal blocked review without changing the registry, and native System Settings restoration recovered that same read. This is a diagnostic prototype, not final-candidate or full lifecycle acceptance. Repeat refusal/restoration/restart, notification initial refusal and the complete same-payload matrix on both Macs; never reset daily permissions.

rules.title: Updates replace one verified application version
rules.breakpoint: Separate native, Python and web copies can leave the installed app behind the preview or start mismatched components.
rules.cause_and_solution: Build a self-contained bundle with pinned standalone Python and Sparkle, copy web resources from an explicit allowlist covering served routes, verify resources before helper startup, correlate helper release identity and retain settings outside the app. Reject unsafe feed settings and untyped updater facts.
rules.required_behavior: No mixed-version UI/helper, no unverified update archive, and no forced termination of an active backup. Developer ID packages retain build 9's app/interpreter/cloud-helper Team IDs, code identifiers and designated requirements; a different or code-hash-only identity stops packaging and archive preparation. Unlisted web files never ship; missing or linked required web assets fail packaging. Test apps cannot use the daily identity or port.
rules.remaining_gap: Historical isolated acceptance on 985814d passed cancellation, signed replacement, invalid signature, truncation, equal-version/busy refusal and injected-failure rollback with unchanged fixture data. October 22 Dev build 9 passed Developer ID/notarization and was installed on the Pro with unchanged protected configuration. Leo granted Desktop access after the ad-hoc-to-Developer-ID identity transition. Signed-to-signed privacy-grant continuity and a subsequent installed Sparkle update remain unverified; signature compatibility is necessary evidence, not proof of TCC consent retention. Air acceptance remains pending.

rules.title: Only accepted main source becomes an update
rules.breakpoint: A branch check, stale run, partial upload or broad cleanup can publish unaccepted bytes or remove unrelated releases.
rules.cause_and_solution: Require a successful exact-main push gate and matching job, monotonic versions, production receipts and scoped current-plus-three package retention. Git tags stay intact.
rules.required_behavior: No publication from forks or PRs; no stale-main promotion; no test archive or unrelated release deletion.
rules.remaining_gap: Personal release 0.0.1 was automatically published and bootstrapped on the Pro with unchanged protected hashes and 13 repos. Launch Services registration before login-agent bootstrap resolved observed EIO after two restored attempts. Complete the follow-up real Sparkle upgrade; Apple signing/permission continuity and the Air matrix remain deferred.

rules.title: Settings persist only through explicit reviewed saves
rules.breakpoint: Closing a dirty settings page can silently lose a draft; repeated submits or stale revisions can overwrite saved choices.
rules.cause_and_solution: Keep local drafts, guard Back/Close/Escape, serialize saves and preserve the existing session-token and revision-checked API boundary. Folder persistence has workspace_configuration evidence; effective saved scheduling policy appears in schedule_decision. Discard-only UI paths are covered by controller regressions, not claimed as save events.
rules.required_behavior: No persistence from editing or navigation. Failed saves keep the draft. Folder choices retain review and revision protections.
rules.remaining_gap: Actual isolated browser checks cover schedule edits/save/discard/reload, folder-mode discard and a long access list with a fixed toolbar. Shared-controller regressions cover both menu and full-page folder hosts. Native Settings layout, permission actions and folder picking are not validated by these browser cases; no installed app or daily configuration changed.

rules.title: First-run setup cannot activate an unreviewed or partial configuration
rules.breakpoint: Fresh packages required a pre-existing personal config; independent settings saves could expose only part of a setup draft.
rules.cause_and_solution: Bootstrap empty manual sources with backups disabled. Review helper-observed access against the exact draft/revision, then serialize and journal application. Recover before starting scans or backups; keep current operation until explicit apply.
rules.required_behavior: New installs remain idle until explicit reviewed save. Denied, changed, busy or stale requests cannot activate a draft. Reload discards unsaved choices and stale discovery/access/completion UI without browser confirmation or configuration writes. Existing configurations and optional permission choices survive. Native bootstrap and exact trusted welcome-page bridge checks run in the macOS gate.
rules.remaining_gap: Final native welcome-window layout, folder picker, real macOS permission refusal/recovery and installed update acceptance must be recorded separately. Synthetic permission failures do not prove TCC behavior.

rules.title: Readable backup paths preserve identity and verified archives
rules.breakpoint: Workspace IDs doubled as user-visible folder names; naive renames or destination changes can lose indexes, reuse an old upload receipt or overwrite another repo.
rules.cause_and_solution: Keep IDs in metadata, compute collision-safe readable parent groups and journal staged renames with archive verification. Bind the chosen iCloud destination to physical identity. Destination switches keep prior archives and require a new local copy.
rules.required_behavior: No arbitrary hash suffixes, foreign-folder overwrite, source overlap, silent destination rebinding or pruning of old-location archives. Every moved archive is verified, and upload evidence is re-observed for the new path. Native backup navigation uses the helper's selected existing physical root, with no hard-coded fallback or page-supplied path; macOS bridge checks cover this boundary.
rules.remaining_gap: Real iCloud folder renames, file-provider placeholders, disk interruption and re-observed upload acknowledgement require native acceptance. Other cloud providers are outside this release.

rules.title: Recursive Git discovery returns bounded candidates without enabling them
rules.breakpoint: Unbounded recursion, Git-looking files or external worktree storage can yield unsafe or misleading source selections.
rules.cause_and_solution: Scan explicitly with depth/count/time limits and cancellation. Validate Git metadata without running hooks. Skip linked and protected directories; disclose invalid/external layouts and incomplete areas. Add only user-selected results to the existing individual-folder draft.
rules.required_behavior: Discovery never activates repos, removes non-Git selections or changes repo-home behavior. Incomplete, cancelled or failed scans are not reported as complete empty success. Cancellation accepted before final publication remains cancelled with partial diagnostics, including during the last identity check. Existing source-review and identity checks still govern saves.
rules.remaining_gap: Large real inventories and unusual Git layouts need observed runs. External Git storage is explicitly unsupported by discovery; no background auto-add is implemented.

rules.title: Experimental update channels cannot silently promote Stable
rules.breakpoint: A single latest-release feed exposed every successful main build publicly; channel changes or promotion could lose provenance, skip acceptance or rebuild a different archive.
rules.cause_and_solution: Default each Mac to Stable; expose Dev/Testing only after an explicit Boolean local opt-in read at launch. Enforce the same policy in native selection, settings rendering and bounded diagnostics, including preexisting Dev preferences. Keep fixed feeds and guarded revision-checked saves. Publish Dev locally after focused clean-source checks, require exact successful full-gate runs for Testing, and require explicit approval plus both-host exact-package acceptance for notarized Stable promotion. Reserve global builds under a repository lock and verify uploaded bytes and archive signatures before changing feeds.
rules.required_behavior: Absent, false or malformed opt-in means Stable only; hidden controls cannot authorize experimental saves. Removing the opt-in suppresses saved Dev/Testing preferences on restart without changing unrelated settings or backup readiness. Malformed or contradictory UI/diagnostic policy evidence fails closed. Experimental publication preserves public latest. Local Dev provisioning verifies existing keys before saving in Keychain; repeated releases load credentials only after the clean-source gate, never request pasted secrets, never expose child signing output, and allow a fresh run after failure. Missing/locked credentials and an untrusted helper fail closed. Publisher keys/tools never ship in the app. Promotion changes metadata only and retains archive bytes. Skipped/stale gates, malformed or wrong-channel feeds, foreign sources and incomplete acceptance fail closed. Interrupted promotion requires explicit resume and rechecks. Channel diagnostics are bounded and never establish backup or upload success.
rules.remaining_gap: Synthetic GitHub tests and public-key fixtures do not prove live prerelease/feed publication, Apple notarization, channel changes in the installed native app or Pro/Air update continuity. Those require separately authorized live delivery and native acceptance.
